title: A journey on the All Journeys page
description: One payment journey, drawn by JourneyMap. Each file is one journey.

title.title: Title
title.description: The journey's name, shown at the top of the diagram.

eyebrow.title: Eyebrow
eyebrow.description: The small line above the title, such as "Immediate payment".

kind.title: Kind
enumDescriptions: A customer asks and waits for the answer
An event, a callback or a date starts it, with nobody waiting

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: The ways in, such as Web or Mobile app.

note.title: Note
note.description: Shown when you hover over the origin.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What kind of entry point this is. It sets the tooltip and the colour of the chip.
enumDescriptions: A One-Data function
A Billpay core API
An inbound event
Held in One-Data's inbox until Billpay pulls it
A Temporal Schedule
A dispatcher, which starts work at the rate the governor sets

label.title: Name
label.description: The name as it appears, such as CreatePayment.v3 or POST /payments.

note.title: Note
note.description: A short note shown beside it.

entry.title: Through
entry.description: The One-Data functions, inbox or events the request comes in through.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What kind of Billpay endpoint this is. It sets the tooltip and the colour of the chip.
enumDescriptions: A One-Data function
A Billpay core API
An inbound event
Held in One-Data's inbox until Billpay pulls it
A Temporal Schedule
A dispatcher, which starts work at the rate the governor sets

label.title: Name
label.description: The name as it appears, such as CreatePayment.v3 or POST /payments.

note.title: Note
note.description: A short note shown beside it.

core.title: Billpay
core.description: The Billpay core APIs, Schedules or dispatchers that receive it.

workflow.title: Runs as
workflow.description: The Temporal workflows that run the journey, in order.

child.title: Child workflow
child.description: true if a parent workflow starts this one.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: The steps, left to right. Leave this out for a journey that has no steps to draw, and give a status instead.

name.title: Step name
name.description: Short, such as Capture or Customer back.

state.title: State
state.description: The payment's lifecycle state once this step is done. Use the state's name in capitals, as on the State Model page.

mode.title: Who waits
mode.description: Whether a caller is waiting while this step runs.
enumDescriptions: A caller waits for this step (drawn in the Sync box)
Nobody waits; it runs in the background
The step waits for something from outside before it runs

caption.title: Caption
caption.description: One line shown when you hover over the step.

reply.title: Reply
reply.description: Where the workflow answers its caller, such as "to the caller with ACCEPTED or DECLINED".

systems.title: Calls
systems.description: The systems this step calls, by their names in diagrams/systems.yaml. The check on a pull request makes sure each one is on that list.

items.title: System
items.description: A system's name exactly as diagrams/systems.yaml writes it, such as Payment Instruments or GAR.

trigger.title: Trigger
trigger.description: Something from outside that starts or resumes this step. Drawn in pink.

kind.title: How it arrives
enumDescriptions: A Temporal update to the running workflow, which answers its sender
A Temporal signal to the running workflow, with no answer back
A partner system calls Billpay back
A dispatcher picks up a due row
Events from other systems, paired in One-Data's inbox

name.title: Event name
name.description: The name shown in the lane, such as Channel Confirm Event.

poll.title: Repeated call
poll.description: A call made again and again until it has an answer.

exit.title: Ends
exit.description: Where the payment can leave the journey at this step. One end, or a list of them.

state.title: State
state.description: The state the payment ends in if it leaves here. Leave it out for an end that is not a state, such as an exception list.

label.title: Why
label.description: A few words on why it ends here, such as "no link" or "failed".

state.title: State
state.description: The state the payment ends in if it leaves here. Leave it out for an end that is not a state, such as an exception list.

label.title: Why
label.description: A few words on why it ends here, such as "no link" or "failed".

arrives.title: Arrives as
arrives.description: The word on the first step's arrow, such as "create". Defaults to "request" or "start".

table.title: Table
table.description: A table this step works in, such as allocation_batch.

waiting.title: Waiting
waiting.description: Forces the pale waiting look. Normally "mode: awaiting" does this.

links.title: Links
links.description: Lines from this step to other steps in the same journey, such as a retry or a skip. Drawn in the Links lane under the diagram.

to.title: To
to.description: The name of the step the line goes to, written exactly as that step's name.

label.title: Why
label.description: A few words shown on the line, such as retry.

detail.title: Notes
detail.description: The numbered notes under the diagram. Use **bold**, `code` and [links](#anchor) as on any page.

step.title: Step
step.description: The step number this note explains. Leave it out for a note between steps.

detailLabel.title: Notes heading
detailLabel.description: Defaults to "How this works, step by step".

detailOpen.title: Notes open
detailOpen.description: true to show the notes open.

status.title: Status
status.description: For a journey with no steps: why there is nothing to draw.

enumDescriptions: Still being defined
Not yet mapped in the spec
Read-only, no workflow
